title: Factorized concept Mirror coordinates and held-out combination extrapolation
hypothesis: With two binary attributes and combination 11 entirely held out, factorized attribute-specific Givens Mirror coordinates composed on a shared MLP achieve >=5pp higher held-out-combination accuracy per payload byte than factorized FiLM and a direct combination-coordinate table, while retaining >=90% of seen-combination accuracy.
mirror_coordinate: one learned Givens angle per attribute, composed as disjoint rotations
logical_multiplicity: four attribute-combination functions from two independent factors
controls: direct per-combination Mirror table with held-out code fixed to zero
oracle independent per-combination MLP trained on all combinations

task.teacher: two disjoint attribute Givens rotations composed before one shared random ReLU MLP

development.selection_metric: held-out validation accuracy on seen combinations only; tie-break lower seen validation cross entropy

success_gate: On every fresh world, factorized Mirror held-out-combination accuracy is >=5pp above factorized FiLM and direct code-table baselines, >=90% of its own seen-combination accuracy, and its serialized payload is <=1.1x factorized FiLM bytes.
failure_gate: Mirror misses extrapolation or byte gate, or a simpler factorized control matches or exceeds held-out quality at similar bytes.
boundaries: Teacher is explicitly generated by the Mirror factor composition; only aligned feasibility is tested.
The independent upper control sees held-out training examples and is not a zero-shot comparator.
No natural concept or language-model claim.
